marketing_description: The Milwaukee 2847-20 Gangbox Rapid Charger is designed for use with M18 REDLITHIUM batteries, delivering 175W continuous wattage for fast power to personal electronics. It features an AC 120V outlet, USB-C PD port, and USB-A port, providing up to 45W output for fast-charging laptops and mobile devices. The rafter hook allows for convenient hanging on jobsite materials.
